• Hold USDM 2x
• Staking in sUSDM 5x
• Providing liquidity to the USDC/USDM pool on Hybra 10x
• Providing liquidity to the HYPE/USDM pool on Hybra 15x
1. Go to the [website](https://www.monetrix.xyz/app/dashboard?code=6AEAMQ4W)and connect your wallet
By using the referral link, you’ll receive an extra 10% boost to the points you earn
2. Swap USDC for USDM in the [Earn section](https://www.monetrix.xyz/app/earn)
3. Open the [DeFi section](https://www.monetrix.xyz/app/defi), select the liquidity pool you are interested in, and deposit funds into the pool on Hybra
Please note that, in addition to points, you will also earn a return depending on the pool you select
4. You can also [send](https://www.monetrix.xyz/app/earn)USDM to staking
5. In the [Tasks section](https://www.monetrix.xyz/app/tasks), complete the available tasks to earn extra points
